name: Open a URL in a browser window
description: Opens a URL in the chosen browser (default: firefox; or chrome, chromium, edge) and verifies a browser window shows up. To use the system default browser instead, call app action "open" with the URL.

parameters.name: title_hint
parameters.description: Regex expected in the window title once loaded.

steps.title: Launch the browser with the URL

failure_modes.symptom: Browser opened but page shows an error
failure_modes.recovery: screen_text to read the error (offline, DNS); verify http_ok on the URL.
